summary: iter41 promo-redemption bug-fix review. Backend fix (writing to canonical pro_until / plan / pro_source and additive stacking) is FULLY verified — 14/14 pytest checks pass, including validate/redeem happy paths, unknown/inactive/max-uses/double-redeem negatives, discount-code redirection, additive stacking (+30d then +10d ⇒ ~40d left), free-tier 3-session cap being lifted after redemption, and admin redemption-count increment. HOWEVER a FRONTEND stale-state bug was found: after `/promo/redeem` succeeds and the user taps 'Start your first Pro session' from the ThankYouCelebration, the Dashboard still shows PRO INCLUDES banner, sound-bath-pro-badge, sound-bath-unlock-cta, meditation-pro-badge, and locks on all Pro features. `/api/me/subscription` returns pro:true, pro_source:'promo:WELCOME30', is_promo_pro:true — the SubscriptionContext just isn't being refreshed. A full page reload immediately fixes the UI, confirming this is a client-side context-refresh miss, not a server issue.

integration_issues.flow: Comp promo redemption → return to Dashboard
integration_issues.issue: After AccountDashboard.redeemPromo() succeeds, the global SubscriptionContext is never refreshed. AccountDashboard.jsx L263 only calls the local `load()` (rehydrates its own useState `sub`), but Dashboard.jsx reads `isPro` from `useSubscription()` context (SubscriptionContext.js). So tapping ThankYouCelebration → onStart → onBack() returns the user to a Dashboard that still thinks isPro=false: PRO INCLUDES banner visible, sound-bath-pro-badge visible, sound-bath-unlock-cta visible, meditation-pro-badge visible, Sleep Mode/Golden Stack/Custom frequency/Brainwave/Custom Flow all still locked. A hard page reload immediately corrects the UI, proving it's purely a stale-context bug. FIX: in AccountDashboard.jsx redeemPromo (~L257), grab `refresh` from `useSubscription()` and call `await refresh()` right after `api.post('/promo/redeem', …)` (or inside the ThankYouCelebration onStart callback at L1088). One-line change.

GET /api/me/subscription after redeem → pro:true, plan:'pro', pro_source:'promo:WELCOME30', is_promo_pro:true, days_left ∈ [28,31]
POST /api/promo/redeem WELCOME30 twice → 2nd call 400 'You've already redeemed this code.'
POST /api/promo/redeem <inactive comp> → 400 'This code has been deactivated.'
POST /api/promo/redeem <comp with max_uses=1 already spent> → 400 'This code has reached its redemption limit.'
POST /api/promo/redeem SAVE20 (discount) → 400 telling user discount codes apply at checkout, not /promo/redeem
Free tier: 3 saved sessions succeed (200), 4th returns 402 'Free plan saves up to 3…'. After redeeming WELCOME30, sessions 4-6 also succeed (200)
Additive stacking: WELCOME30 (30d) then a 10d comp → days_left grows by ~10 (not overwritten). pro_source updates to latest comp code
Regression: fresh free user reports pro:false, is_promo_pro:false, no pro_source. Admin reports pro:true but NOT is_promo_pro (no promo pro_source)
Admin /api/admin/promo GET shows WELCOME30 redemptions count increments by 1 after each user redeems
verified_frontend_expectations: Free user paywall: promo-entry-input accepts 'WELCOME30', promo-entry-apply → promo-entry-confirmation card shows summary 'Complimentary Pro access for 30 days'
promo-entry-redeem button is rendered ONLY for comp codes
Tapping Redeem → ThankYouCelebration mounts (data-testid=thank-you-celebration), page contains 'complimentary' copy

AFTER a full page reload post-redemption, Dashboard correctly hides pro-preview-banner, sound-bath-pro-badge, sound-bath-unlock-cta, meditation-pro-badge (all query→None). This confirms /me/subscription is correct end-to-end and the ONLY missing piece is client-side context refresh
action_items: FRONTEND FIX (1-line): AccountDashboard.jsx redeemPromo (~L257) must also call SubscriptionContext.refresh() so Dashboard.jsx's `isPro` reflects the new pro_until immediately. Either destructure `refresh` from useSubscription() at the top of AccountDashboard and `await refresh()` after `api.post('/promo/redeem', …)`, OR wire the ThankYouCelebration.onStart (L1088) to `await refresh(); setCompRedeemed(false); onBack();`. Same pattern already needed for consistency with post-checkout celebration at L1076.
critical_code_review_comments: SubscriptionContext.refresh() should ideally also be called after successful Stripe checkout return; currently the celebratingPlan branch (L1076) likely has the same stale-context risk if the user returns to Dashboard via onBack() before a natural refetch. Not covered by this review but worth an audit.
AccountDashboard.jsx maintains its OWN local `sub` state (via load()) which duplicates SubscriptionContext. Consider deriving from context to eliminate the sync burden entirely.
promo/redeem response body could optionally include the fresh subscription snapshot so the client doesn't need a second /me/subscription round-trip — minor perf improvement, non-blocking.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Once main agent wires SubscriptionContext.refresh() into the redeem flow, re-run the /tmp browser script that first verified banner/badges disappear after redeem WITHOUT a reload. The pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_promo_redeem.py is idempotent (uses uuid-based emails and ephemeral admin codes) — safe to re-run any number of times. Note that pytest.ini enables pytest-xdist so tests can race on shared codes like WELCOME30; the current tests are careful to only assert local state or use ephemeral codes, so parallelism is fine.
rca of the issue: Backend bug from the prior implementation (writing pro_expires_at/pro_status which _is_pro didn't read) is FIXED — /promo/redeem now correctly writes pro_until, plan='pro', pro_source, with additive stacking. Additionally uncovered a NEW frontend-only bug: AccountDashboard.redeemPromo does not call SubscriptionContext.refresh(), so the Dashboard route reads stale isPro=false after onBack(), leaving Pro-locked panels visually gated despite backend saying pro:true. Reproduction: register a fresh user, open Account paywall, enter WELCOME30, Apply, Redeem, click Start on the celebration → return to Dashboard → pro-preview-banner and every *-pro-badge/unlock-cta are still visible. Reload the page → they immediately vanish. Mitigation: add `const { refresh } = useSubscription()` in AccountDashboard.jsx and `await refresh()` inside redeemPromo (and post-checkout celebrating flow for consistency).
